mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hyponatremia) and dehydration may potentiate diazepam's CNS depression and increase risk of orthostatic hypotension; diazepam may impair compensatory cardiovascular reflexes to diuretic-induced volume depletion.
action: Monitor electrolytes, blood pressure, and CNS effects; counsel on fall risk and orthostatic precautions; ensure adequate hydration; consider potassium supplementation if hypokalemia develops.
